Name: Quality Fish Ponds 1.6 (Quality Fish and Quality Roe)
Author: ytsc
Description:
[b][size=4]Info[/size][/b]
When you place a fish on the Fish Pond the quality will be recorded, so when you fish it again it will be on the same quality. If you have multiple fish on the pond, it will pull from the last added. Also produces roe with the same quality of a random fish on the fish pond.

Every time the fish multiply there is a 1/3 chance to be Common quality, 1/3 chance of Silver quality and 1/3 chance of Gold quality.
Iridium quality depends on options below:

If you [b]don't[/b] [b]have[/b] the "EnableGaranteedIridum" config enabled and [b]have[/b] the "Angler" fishing profession, the chance of Iridium quality is:
[code](º of Iridium quality fish on the pond * (Luck level/10) / (2 * nº of fish on the pond)
[/code]
If you [b]have[/b] the "EnableGaranteedIridum" config enabled and all the fish on the pond [b]are[/b] iridium quality, the fish will be Iridium quality unless you get a Bad Luck day, in this case it will be Gold quality. 

If you [b]have[/b] the "EnableGaranteedIridum" config enabled and all the fish on the pond [b]aren't[/b] Iridium quality, the formula applies instead.

[size=4][b]Install[/b]
[/size]1. Install latest version of SMAPI.
2. Place the QualityFishPonds mod folder on the mods folder of your game.

[b][size=4]Uninstall[/size][/b]
1. Remove the QualityFishPonds mod folder from the mods folder of your game.

[b][size=4]Compatibility
[/size][/b]Can be compatible with other mods.

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7651]Smaller Fish Ponds (FishWells)[/url]﻿ (1.5.6 only)
[/list]
